QUIC stream buffer helpers, allocation, deletion, and context accessors.

# Purpose
This file implements helper functions for `fd_quic_stream_t` and its transmit buffers. The [`fd_quic_buffer_store`](<#fd_quic_buffer_store>) and [`fd_quic_buffer_load`](<#fd_quic_buffer_load>) functions manage copy operations for a circular buffer used by QUIC stream data. They use the buffer `head`, `tail`, and capacity values to handle both contiguous and wrapped regions in the ring buffer. The code also checks buffer space and validates read offsets before it copies data with `fd_memcpy`.

The file also defines stream allocation and basic stream state functions. [`fd_quic_stream_footprint`](<#fd_quic_stream_footprint>) computes the memory size needed for one stream instance, its transmit buffer, and its transmit acknowledgment buffer, with alignment rules. [`fd_quic_stream_new`](<#fd_quic_stream_new>) initializes a stream in caller-supplied memory, sets buffer pointers, stores the connection pointer, and sets the stream to an unused state. [`fd_quic_stream_delete`](<#fd_quic_stream_delete>) resets list membership fields, and [`fd_quic_stream_set_context`](<#fd_quic_stream_set_context>) and [`fd_quic_stream_get_context`](<#fd_quic_stream_get_context>) store and return the user context pointer for the stream.
